❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Why does 0.1 not convert back exactly?
0.1 has no exact binary fraction, so the 32-bit float stores the nearest value: 0.10000000149…
What are the three fields?
1 sign bit, 8 exponent bits (biased by 127), and 23 mantissa bits holding the fraction after the leading 1.
What do all-1s exponents mean?
Exponent 255 is special: zero mantissa means ±Infinity, nonzero mantissa means NaN.
